title: Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans Terms: Enrollment, Term, Activation and Billing Channel
content:
# Enrollment, Term, Activation and Billing Channel

**Plan terms, Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.**

## 1. Property type and the line segment covered

1.1 The property type is taken from the customer's statement and must satisfy the entry gate of the plan requested. The statement is the customer's own account of the property at the address being enrolled, given before the enrollment is made.

1.2 Exterior line plans cover only the line segment the homeowner is responsible for, from the utility's connection point (curb stop, property-line cleanout, meter or service drop) to the home; condominium owners are not eligible for exterior line plans because the association owns those lines.

## 2. Term

2.1 Each term lasts the plan's term length in calendar months, ending on the day before the same calendar day that many months later, or the last day of the month when that day does not exist.

*Hypothetical example:* a twelve-month term starting on 10 March 2026 ends on 9 March 2027, the day before the same calendar day twelve months later.

## 3. Coverage effective date and activation

3.1 The coverage effective date is the start date plus the plan's waiting period in calendar days.

3.2 The plan activates no earlier than the plan's waiting period in calendar days after the plan is enrolled, counting the enrollment date as day zero.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | the plan is enrolled (its start date on the plan record) |
| Counting | calendar days; the enrollment date is day zero |
| Comparison | activation no earlier than the last day of the waiting period |
| The boundary day itself | qualifies: activation on that day is allowed |
| Authority | Bridgewell's record of the start date |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, a 30-day waiting period assumed):* a plan enrolled on 10 March has 10 March as day zero; 9 April is day 30, and the plan may activate on 9 April. On 8 April, day 29, it may not yet activate.

## 4. Billing channel

4.1 An enrollment through a partner utility may be billed on the utility bill when the plan permits partner utility billing.

4.2 The customer may move billing between the utility bill, card and bank (ACH) billing at any time, effective for the next billing period.

## 5. Transfer

5.1 Plans are not transferable to a new owner when the plan does not allow transfer; the seller cancels and the buyer enrolls.

## Points of application

- The property type is the one fact here taken from the customer rather than from Bridgewell's records.
- A change of billing channel requested in the middle of a billing period takes effect for the next billing period.
